features: 1080P outdoor Wi-Fi pan/tilt camera, 355 pan / 90 tilt
automatic human tracking and human-detection alerts
infrared, full-colour and intelligent night-vision modes
built-in light and siren alarm, two-way audio
standalone use via CloudEye 365 app or as an expansion camera for the Campark SC53/SC54 Wi-Fi NVR kits
release_notes: Specs per official Campark product page (BC1154 single camera for SC53/SC54). Pixel dimensions, sensor, frame rate, codec and night range are not published; no RTSP/ONVIF stated.
